no_adcom_quote.quote: NDA 22-134 was not referred to an advisory committee for the following reasons: 1) There are a number of other approved ophthalmic products in this class of drugs with this indication. 2) Evaluation of the safety data did not reveal particular safety concerns that were unexpected for the antihistamine class with topical ophthalmic use. 3) The design and results of the efficacy trials did not pose particular concerns.

summary: No FDA advisory committee meeting was convened for the Lastacaft (alcaftadine ophthalmic solution 0.25%) NDA 022134. The review documents state the drug was not referred to an AdComm because there are several other approved ophthalmic products in this drug class with the same indication, the safety data revealed no concerns unexpected for the topical ophthalmic antihistamine class, and the efficacy trial design and results posed no particular concerns. Because no committee met, there are no committee-driven linkages to the approval.
